profile.summary: CircleUp Education is an Oakland, California organization that provides training, consulting and coaching in restorative justice, diversity, equity and inclusion, implicit bias, and conflict resolution. It works with schools, nonprofits, companies, cities and government agencies. It was founded in 2014 and describes itself as a social enterprise.
